label: WowType (拼音输入法 · Rust core + fcitx5 C++ / macOS Swift front ends)
behavior: ⚠ typed text must never reach the public unified log — guards.sh public-text allowlist
C ABI contract header — front ends depend on the contract, not on core internals
panic containment at the FFI boundary (session_ffi)
⚠ unsafe block — review at the FFI boundary
input source registration stays in the installer path
boundaries_global: Linux (fcitx5-addon) and macOS share core/src/session.rs and core/src/config.rs — one source of truth; the fcitx5 C++ session is the behavior spec until it migrates to the session ABI
C ABI in core/include/wowtype_core.h is additive only; scripts/abi-smoke.sh gates header↔dylib symbol drift
No declared contextmap edges: the macos↔core and fcitx5↔core boundaries are C ABI + module map, invisible to the language parser — declaring them would produce false stale-declaration findings

core: Strings returned by wowtype_session_* stay valid until the next state-changing call on the same session; sessions are single-threaded
macos: InputMethodKit/TIS glue only; no network (translation not wired); core built --no-default-features (no voice, no microphone entitlement); ~/Library/Caches/<bundle id>/ for the lexicon snapshot
fcitx5-addon: fcitx5 >= 5.1; test/key_harness.cpp is the behavior spec mirrored by core/tests/session_keys.rs
